chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Mithamī from Aban ibn Uthman from Isma'il ibn al-Fadl said:
ai.seo_question: What is the legal penalty for fabricating accusations against non-Muslims under Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith clarifies the juridical distinction between fixed penalties (hadd) and discretionary punishments (ta'zir) regarding false accusations against non-Muslim subjects of the Islamic state (Ahl al-Zimma). It reflects the Shia scholarly view that while the specific hadd for qadhf (false accusation) is reserved for Muslims, the ruler retains the authority to impose ta'zir to maintain social order and justice for the dhimmi community.
